     5	/-!
     6	# Two-Space Projective Strategies: Direct-Sum State Blocks
     7	
     8	This module contains the role-register direct-sum carriers and block-state
     9	construction used to symmetrize a heterogeneous projective strategy.
    10	-/
    11	
    12	@[expose] public section
    13	
    14	open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder
    15	
    16	namespace MIPStarRE.LDT
    17	
    18	open MIPStarRE.Quantum
    19	
    20	namespace ProjStrat
    21	
    22	/-! ### Direct-sum role-register helpers -/
    23	
    24	/-- Direct-sum carrier for the future heterogeneous role symmetrization.
    25	
    26	For a two-space strategy with Alice carrier `ιA` and Bob carrier `ιB`, the later
    27	symmetrized local space will use this tagged direct sum so that Alice's operators
    28	occupy the `Sum.inl` block and Bob's operators occupy the `Sum.inr` block. -/
    29	abbrev LocalCarrierSum (ιA ιB : Type*) := Sum ιA ιB
    30	
    31	/-- Local carrier planned for the heterogeneous symmetrization bridge: a role bit
    32	and a direct-sum carrier. This is the direct-sum analogue of the current
    33	same-space target `Role × ι` in `StrategyRole.lean`. -/
    34	abbrev RoleRegisterLocal (ιA ιB : Type*) := Role × LocalCarrierSum ιA ιB
    35	
    36	/-- Reassociate role bits and direct-sum carriers.
    37	
    38	This is the public heterogeneous analogue of the same-space role-register
    39	reassociation used internally by `StrategyRole.lean`. It prepares the target
    40	shape for reindexing block states on
    41	`(Role × (ιA ⊕ ιB)) × (Role × (ιA ⊕ ιB))`. -/
    42	def roleRegisterPairLocalEquiv (ιA ιB : Type*) :
    43	    ((Role × Role) × (LocalCarrierSum ιA ιB × LocalCarrierSum ιA ιB)) ≃
    44	      (RoleRegisterLocal ιA ιB × RoleRegisterLocal ιA ιB) where
    45	  toFun x := ((x.1.1, x.2.1), (x.1.2, x.2.2))
    46	  invFun x := ((x.1.1, x.2.1), (x.1.2, x.2.2))
    47	  left_inv := fun ⟨⟨_, _⟩, ⟨_, _⟩⟩ => rfl
    48	  right_inv := fun ⟨⟨_, _⟩, ⟨_, _⟩⟩ => rfl
    49	
    50	/-! ### Direct-sum block states for heterogeneous role symmetrization -/
    51	
    52	/-- Embed an operator on Alice's and Bob's original tensor product into the
    53	`(Sum.inl _) × (Sum.inr _)` block of the direct-sum tensor product. -/
    54	noncomputable def localPairABBlock {ιA ιB : Type*}
    55	    (X : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (ιA × ιB)) :
    56	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (LocalCarrierSum ιA ιB × LocalCarrierSum ιA ιB) :=
    57	  Matrix.of fun x y =>
    58	    match x, y with
    59	    | (Sum.inl i, Sum.inr j), (Sum.inl i', Sum.inr j') => X (i, j) (i', j')
    60	    | _, _ => 0
    61	
    62	/-- Embed an operator on Bob's and Alice's original tensor product into the
    63	`(Sum.inr _) × (Sum.inl _)` block of the direct-sum tensor product. -/
    64	noncomputable def localPairBABlock {ιA ιB : Type*}
    65	    (X : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (ιB × ιA)) :
    66	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (LocalCarrierSum ιA ιB × LocalCarrierSum ιA ιB) :=
    67	  Matrix.of fun x y =>
    68	    match x, y with
    69	    | (Sum.inr i, Sum.inl j), (Sum.inr i', Sum.inl j') => X (i, j) (i', j')
    70	    | _, _ => 0
    71	
    72	@[simp] theorem localPairABBlock_AB_AB {ιA ιB : Type*}
    73	    (X : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (ιA × ιB)) (i i' : ιA) (j j' : ιB) :
    74	    localPairABBlock X (Sum.inl i, Sum.inr j) (Sum.inl i', Sum.inr j') =
    75	      X (i, j) (i', j') :=
    76	  rfl
    77	
    78	@[simp] theorem localPairBABlock_BA_BA {ιA ιB : Type*}
    79	    (X : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (ιB × ιA)) (i i' : ιB) (j j' : ιA) :
    80	    localPairBABlock X (Sum.inr i, Sum.inl j) (Sum.inr i', Sum.inl j') =
    81	      X (i, j) (i', j') :=
    82	  rfl
    83	
    84	@[simp] theorem localPairABBlock_conjTranspose {ιA ιB : Type*}
    85	    (X : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (ιA × ιB)) :
    86	    (localPairABBlock X)ᴴ = localPairABBlock Xᴴ := by
    87	  ext x y
    88	  rcases x with ⟨x₁, x₂⟩
    89	  rcases y with ⟨y₁, y₂⟩
    90	  cases x₁ <;> cases x₂ <;> cases y₁ <;> cases y₂ <;>
    91	    simp [localPairABBlock]
    92	
    93	@[simp] theorem localPairBABlock_conjTranspose {ιA ιB : Type*}
    94	    (X : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (ιB × ιA)) :
    95	    (localPairBABlock X)ᴴ = localPairBABlock Xᴴ := by
    96	  ext x y
    97	  rcases x with ⟨x₁, x₂⟩
    98	  rcases y with ⟨y₁, y₂⟩
    99	  cases x₁ <;> cases x₂ <;> cases y₁ <;> cases y₂ <;>
   100	    simp [localPairBABlock]
   101	
   102	@[simp] theorem localPairABBlock_mul {ιA ιB : Type*} [Fintype ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   103	    (X Y : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (ιA × ιB)) :
   104	    localPairABBlock X * localPairABBlock Y = localPairABBlock (X * Y) := by
   105	  ext x y
   106	  rcases x with ⟨x₁, x₂⟩
   107	  rcases y with ⟨y₁, y₂⟩
   108	  cases x₁ with
   109	  | inl i =>
   110	      cases x₂ with
   111	      | inl j =>
   112	          cases y₁ <;> cases y₂ <;> simp [localPairABBlock, Matrix.mul_apply]
   113	      | inr j =>
   114	          cases y₁ with
   115	          | inl i' =>
   116	              cases y₂ with
   117	              | inl j' => simp [localPairABBlock, Matrix.mul_apply]
   118	              | inr j' =>
   119	                  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
   120	                  simp only [Fintype.sum_sum_type, localPairABBlock, Matrix.of_apply,
   121	                    zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add, add_zero]
   122	                  exact (Fintype.sum_prod_type'
   123	                    (f := fun x : ιA => fun y : ιB =>
   124	                      X (i, j) (x, y) * Y (x, y) (i', j'))).symm
   125	          | inr i' =>
   126	              cases y₂ <;> simp [localPairABBlock, Matrix.mul_apply]
   127	  | inr i =>
   128	      cases x₂ <;> cases y₁ <;> cases y₂ <;> simp [localPairABBlock, Matrix.mul_apply]
   129	
   130	@[simp] theorem localPairBABlock_mul {ιA ιB : Type*} [Fintype ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   131	    (X Y : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (ιB × ιA)) :
   132	    localPairBABlock X * localPairBABlock Y = localPairBABlock (X * Y) := by
   133	  ext x y
   134	  rcases x with ⟨x₁, x₂⟩
   135	  rcases y with ⟨y₁, y₂⟩
   136	  cases x₁ with
   137	  | inl i =>
   138	      cases x₂ <;> cases y₁ <;> cases y₂ <;> simp [localPairBABlock, Matrix.mul_apply]
   139	  | inr i =>
   140	      cases x₂ with
   141	      | inl j =>
   142	          cases y₁ with
   143	          | inl i' =>
   144	              cases y₂ <;> simp [localPairBABlock, Matrix.mul_apply]
   145	          | inr i' =>
   146	              cases y₂ with
   147	              | inl j' =>
   148	                  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
   149	                  simp only [Fintype.sum_sum_type, localPairBABlock, Matrix.of_apply,
   150	                    zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add, add_zero]
   151	                  exact (Fintype.sum_prod_type'
   152	                    (f := fun x : ιB => fun y : ιA =>
   153	                      X (i, j) (x, y) * Y (x, y) (i', j'))).symm
   154	              | inr j' => simp [localPairBABlock, Matrix.mul_apply]
   155	      | inr j =>
   156	          cases y₁ <;> cases y₂ <;> simp [localPairBABlock, Matrix.mul_apply]

   412	/-- Normalizing scalar for the direct-sum heterogeneous role-register state. -/
   413	noncomputable def roleRegisterDensityScale (ιA ιB : Type*) [Fintype ιA] [Fintype ιB] :
   414	    Error :=
   415	  2 * ((Fintype.card (LocalCarrierSum ιA ιB) : Error) ^ (2 : ℕ)) /
   416	    ((Fintype.card ιA : Error) * (Fintype.card ιB : Error))
   417	
   418	theorem roleRegisterDensityScale_nonneg (ιA ιB : Type*) [Fintype ιA] [Fintype ιB] :
   419	    0 ≤ roleRegisterDensityScale ιA ιB := by
   420	  unfold roleRegisterDensityScale
   421	  positivity
   422	
   423	/-- Heterogeneous role-register symmetrization of a two-space bipartite state.
   424	
   425	The state lives on `Role × (ιA ⊕ ιB)` on each side.  Its occupied sectors are
   426	`A/B`, carrying the original density in the `Sum.inl × Sum.inr` direct-sum
   427	block, and `B/A`, carrying the swapped density in the `Sum.inr × Sum.inl` block.
   428	The scalar compensates for normalized trace on the enlarged direct-sum carrier.
   429	Normalization and the LDT goodness comparison are separate lemmas. -/
   430	noncomputable def roleRegisterSymmState {ιA ιB : Type*}
   431	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   432	    (ψ : QuantumState (ιA × ιB)) :
   433	    QuantumState (RoleRegisterLocal ιA ιB × RoleRegisterLocal ιA ιB) where
   434	  density :=
   435	    roleRegisterDensityScale ιA ιB •
   436	      rolePairDirectSumCond Role.A Role.B (localPairABBlock ψ.density) +
   437	    roleRegisterDensityScale ιA ιB •
   438	      rolePairDirectSumCond Role.B Role.A
   439	        (localPairBABlock (heterogeneousSwapDensity ψ.density))
   440	  density_psd := add_nonneg
   441	    (smul_nonneg (roleRegisterDensityScale_nonneg ιA ιB)
   442	      (rolePairDirectSumCond_nonneg Role.A Role.B
   443	        (localPairABBlock_nonneg ψ.density_psd)))
   444	    (smul_nonneg (roleRegisterDensityScale_nonneg ιA ιB)
   445	      (rolePairDirectSumCond_nonneg Role.B Role.A
   446	        (localPairBABlock_nonneg (heterogeneousSwapDensity_nonneg ψ.density_psd))))
   447	
   448	@[simp] theorem roleRegisterSymmState_density_fixed {ιA ιB : Type*}
   449	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   450	    (ψ : QuantumState (ιA × ιB)) :
   451	    swapDensity (roleRegisterSymmState ψ).density =
   452	      (roleRegisterSymmState ψ).density := by
   453	  calc
   454	    swapDensity (roleRegisterSymmState ψ).density
   455	      = roleRegisterDensityScale ιA ιB •
   456	          rolePairDirectSumCond Role.B Role.A
   457	            (localPairBABlock (heterogeneousSwapDensity ψ.density)) +
   458	        roleRegisterDensityScale ιA ιB •
   459	          rolePairDirectSumCond Role.A Role.B
   460	            (localPairABBlock ψ.density) := by
   461	            let s : Error := roleRegisterDensityScale ιA ιB
   462	            let A := rolePairDirectSumCond Role.A Role.B (localPairABBlock ψ.density)
   463	            let B := rolePairDirectSumCond Role.B Role.A
   464	              (localPairBABlock (heterogeneousSwapDensity ψ.density))

   466	            rw [swapDensity_add]
   467	            have hAB : swapDensity (s • A) = s • B := by
   468	              change swapDensity ((s : ℂ) • A) = (s : ℂ) • B
   469	              rw [swapDensity_smul]
   470	              simp [A, B]
   471	            have hBA : swapDensity (s • B) = s • A := by
   472	              change swapDensity ((s : ℂ) • B) = (s : ℂ) • A
   473	              rw [swapDensity_smul]
   474	              simp [A, B]
   475	            rw [hAB, hBA]

   477	          simp [roleRegisterSymmState, add_comm]
   478

   481	    (ψ : QuantumState (ιA × ιB)) :

   484	    (roleRegisterSymmState_density_fixed ψ)

   487	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Nonempty ιA]
   488	    [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB] [Nonempty ιB]
   489	    (ψ : QuantumState (ιA × ιB)) (hψ : ψ.IsNormalized) :
   490	    (roleRegisterSymmState ψ).IsNormalized := by
   491	  unfold QuantumState.IsNormalized roleRegisterSymmState

   499	          rolePairDirectSumCond Role.B Role.A

   504	    normalizedTrace_rolePairDirectSumCond,

   507	    normalizedTrace_heterogeneousSwapDensity, hψ]

    81	  if warn.sorry.get (← getOptions) then
    82	    if !(← MonadLog.hasErrors) && decl.hasSorry then
    83	      -- Find an actual sorry expression to use for `sorry`.
    84	      -- That way the user can hover over it to see its type and use "go to definition" if it is a labeled sorry.
    85	      let findSorry : StateRefT (Array (Bool × MessageData)) MetaM Unit := decl.forEachSorryM fun s => do
    86	        let s' ← addMessageContext s
    87	        modify fun arr => arr.push (s.isSyntheticSorry, s')
    88	      let (_, sorries) ← findSorry |>.run #[] |>.run'
    89	      -- Prefer reporting a synthetic sorry.
    90	      -- These can appear without logged errors if `decl` is referring to declarations with elaboration errors;
    91	      -- that's where a user should direct their focus.
    92	      if let some (_, s) := sorries.find? (·.1) <|> sorries[0]? then
    93	        logWarning <| .tagged `hasSorry m!"declaration uses `{s}`"
    94	      else
    95	        -- This case should not happen, but it ensures a warning will get logged no matter what.
    96	        logWarning <| .tagged `hasSorry m!"declaration uses `sorry`"

   101	private def addDeclCore (decl : Declaration) (forceExpose : Bool) : CoreM Unit :=
   102	  withTraceNode `addDecl (fun _ => return m!"adding declarations {decl.getNames}") do
   103	  -- register namespaces for newly added constants; this used to be done by the kernel itself
   104	  -- but that is incompatible with moving it to a separate task
   105	  -- NOTE: we do not use `getTopLevelNames` here so that inductive types are registered as
   106	  -- namespaces
   107	  modifyEnv (decl.getNames.foldl registerNamePrefixes)
   108	
   109	  -- convert `Declaration` to `ConstantInfo` to use as a preliminary value in the environment until

   113	    | .thmDecl thm =>
   114	      if !forceExpose && (← getEnv).header.isModule then
   115	        trace[addDecl] "exporting theorem {thm.name} as axiom"
   116	        exportedInfo? := some <| .axiomInfo { thm with isUnsafe := false }
   117	      pure (thm.name, .thmInfo thm, .thm)
   118	    | .defnDecl defn | .mutualDefnDecl [defn] =>
   119	      if !forceExpose && (← getEnv).header.isModule && !(← getEnv).isExporting then
   120	        trace[addDecl] "exporting definition {defn.name} as axiom"
   121	        exportedInfo? := some <| .axiomInfo { defn with isUnsafe := defn.safety != .safe }
   122	      pure (defn.name, .defnInfo defn, .defn)
   123	    | .opaqueDecl op =>
   124	      if !forceExpose && (← getEnv).header.isModule && !(← getEnv).isExporting then
   125	        trace[addDecl] "exporting opaque {op.name} as axiom"
   126	        exportedInfo? := some <| .axiomInfo { op with }
   127	      pure (op.name, .opaqueInfo op, .opaque)
   128	    | .axiomDecl ax => pure (ax.name, .axiomInfo ax, .axiom)
   129	    | _ =>
   130	      trace[addDecl] "no matching async adding rules, adding synchronously"
   131	      return (← doAdd)
   132	
   133	  -- Check early so we can avoid related env ext panics that would happen before the check in the
   134	  -- kernel.
   135	  if (← getEnv).containsOnBranch name then
   136	    throwKernelException <| .alreadyDeclared (← getEnv).toKernelEnv name
   137	
   138	  if decl.getTopLevelNames.all isPrivateName then
   139	    if (← ResolveName.backward.privateInPublic.getM) then
   140	      trace[addDecl] "private decl under `privateInPublic`, exporting as is"
   141	      exportedInfo? := some info
   142	    else
   143	      trace[addDecl] "not exporting private declaration at all"
   144	      exportedInfo? := none
   145	  else
   146	    -- preserve original constant kind in extension if different from exported one
   147	    if exportedInfo?.isSome then
   148	      modifyEnv (privateConstKindsExt.insert · name kind)
   149	    else
   150	      trace[addDecl] "no matching exporting rules, exporting as is"
   151	      exportedInfo? := some info
   152	
   153	  let env ← getEnv
   154	  -- no environment extension changes to report after kernel checking; ensures we do not
   155	  -- accidentally wait for this snapshot when querying extension states
   156	  let async ← env.addConstAsync (reportExts := false) name kind
   157	    (exportedKind? := exportedInfo?.map (.ofConstantInfo))
   158	  -- report preliminary constant info immediately
   159	  async.commitConst async.asyncEnv (some info) (exportedInfo? <|> info)
   160	  setEnv async.mainEnv
   161	
   162	  let doAddAndCommit := do
   163	    setEnv async.asyncEnv
   164	    try
   165	      doAdd
   166	    finally
   167	      async.commitCheckEnv (← getEnv)
   168	
   169	  if Elab.async.get (← getOptions) then
   170	    let cancelTk ← IO.CancelToken.new
   171	    let checkAct ← Core.wrapAsyncAsSnapshot (cancelTk? := cancelTk) fun _ => doAddAndCommit
   172	    let t ← BaseIO.mapTask checkAct env.checked
   173	    -- Do not display reporting range; most uses of `addDecl` are for registering auxiliary decls
   174	    -- users should not worry about and other callers can add a separate task with ranges
   175	    -- themselves, see `MutualDef`.
   176	    Core.logSnapshotTask { stx? := none, reportingRange := .skip, task := t, cancelTk? := cancelTk }
   177	  else
   178	    try
   179	      doAddAndCommit
   180	    finally
   181	      setEnv async.mainEnv
   182	where
   183	  doAdd := do
   184	    profileitM Exception "type checking" (← getOptions) do
   185	      withTraceNode `Kernel (fun _ => return m!"typechecking declarations {decl.getTopLevelNames}") do
   186	        warnIfUsesSorry decl
   187	        try
   188	          let env ← (← getEnv).addDeclAux (← getOptions) decl (← read).cancelTk?

   190	          setEnv env
   191	        catch ex =>

   193	          addAsAxiom

   195	  addAsAxiom := do
   196	    -- try to add as axiom with given type for def/theorem

   198	    | .defnDecl d | .thmDecl d =>
   199	      let fallbackDecl := .axiomDecl {
   200	        name := d.name, levelParams := d.levelParams, type := d.type, isUnsafe := false
   201	      }
   202	      try
   203	        let env ← (← getEnv).addDeclAux (← getOptions) fallbackDecl (← read).cancelTk?
   204	          |> ofExceptKernelException
   205	        setEnv env
   206	        return
   207	      catch _ => pure ()
   208	    | _ => pure ()
   209	
   210	    -- otherwise, add as axiom with type `sorry`
   211	    for n in decl.getNames do
   212	      let fallbackDecl := .axiomDecl {
   213	        name := n, levelParams := []
   214	        type := mkApp2 (mkConst ``sorryAx [1]) (mkSort 0) (mkConst ``true), isUnsafe := false
   215	      }
   216	      try
   217	        let env ← (← getEnv).addDeclAux (← getOptions) fallbackDecl (← read).cancelTk?
   218	          |> ofExceptKernelException
   219	        setEnv env
   220	        return
   221	      catch _ => pure ()

   194	/--
   195	An environment stores declarations provided by the user. The kernel

   198	parameterized by a sequence of universe parameters.

   200	the kernel is to type check these declarations and refuse type incorrect ones. The
   201	kernel does not allow declarations containing metavariables and/or free variables
   202	to be added to an environment. Environments are never destructively updated.
   203	
   204	The environment also contains a collection of extensions. For example, the `simp` theorems
   205	declared by users are stored in an environment extension. Users can declare new extensions
   206	using meta-programming.

   210	  The constructor of `Environment` is private to protect against modification that bypasses the

   212	  -/
   213	  private mk ::

   215	  Mapping from constant name to `ConstantInfo`. It contains all constants (definitions, theorems,
